tools.name: cs2_money_rules
tools.description: FREE CS2 money rules: loss bonus, round rewards, kill rewards. Competitive/Premier economy: start $800, cap $16,000, loss bonus ladder, win/bomb rewards, plant bonus, kill rewards by weapon class. Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: cs2_next_round_money
tools.description: FREE CS2 next-round money after a win or loss. Given each player's money, side and loss count, returns everyone's money next round if you win or lose (with plant bonus for T) and the next loss bonus. Always free. (free, no payment)
